subject: modify aesthetics of network plots produced by gl.grm.network?

messages.author: d7b556bd4c296501
messages.subject: modify aesthetics of network plots produced by gl.grm.network?
parts:
Hello DartR team!

Thank you very much for your in depth response to my previous question about GRM network methods implemented in DartR! We have found some interesting results and would like to include some network plots in our manuscript. I was wondering if there are any advanced tinkering options for the aesthetics of the plots, such as modifying the transparency of certain nodes (e.g. 'alpha' option in ggplot2) or changing the line color/type for the connections between nodes? 

Thank you!

Evan

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: modify aesthetics of network plots produced by gl.grm.network?
parts:
Hi Evan,

I include in the function the parameters you suggested. To use these changes you need to install the development version of dartR by typing in the R console:

> library(dartR)
> gl.install.vanilla.dartR(flavour = "dev")

After installing, you can try:

library(dartR)
test <- platypus.gl
grm <- gl.grm(test,plotheatmap = FALSE,verbose = 0)
res <- gl.grm.network(grm,
                      test,
                      node.size =8,
                      node.alpha = 1/2,
                      link.color = "red",
                      link.size = 3)

Cheers,
Luis
